O.outcome_detail: number of schools operated despite enrollment change

cells.quote: Bellwether has found that 68 percent of K–12 districts experienced enrollment declines between 2018–19 and 2023–24. However, most of these districts still operate roughly the same number of schools—a mismatch that federal COVID-19 funding relief temporarily masked.
cells.note: The study text reports the prevalence of enrollment decline and a mismatch between enrollment and school counts, but does not report a direct comparison group, inferential test, or causal design.

cells.quote: Following the group and individual meetings with the expert panel, 68 initial competencies were developed within three broad categories: (A) psychological foundations of serious illness care (17 competencies), (B) psychiatric disorders in serious illness (43 competencies), and (C) systems-based practice (8 competencies).
cells.note: The study reports consensus-based competency generation rather than a learning intervention or treatment-versus-comparison outcome; no comparative effect is reported.
